providerContractChange: Current deepseek-v4-flash thinking mode rejected forced tool_choice with HTTP 400; HD6 therefore used response_format=json_object plus full post-parse local schema validation. Strict-validity rates are not directly comparable to prior function-call waves.

historicalMemoryLeakage.finding: At a 1973 cutoff, proposals repeatedly jump to a cost-based optimizer and in one affordance trial to hash/merge-join details. The direction is useful, but specificity exceeds clean packet evidence.
All three trials identify the later non-metallic/carbon route; one explicitly names LiCoO2, graphite/petroleum coke and an 18650-style cell. This is strong outcome-shaped pretrained-memory leakage.

Before the 1985 ozone-hole publication, several trials target Antarctic/polar-spring chlorine/ozone signatures and ClO. Action classes are available, but target selection leaks later historical knowledge.

affordanceFinding: All 12 affordance trials remain within the declared action classes and all are schema-valid, yet future-specific target/implementation knowledge still appears inside those classes. Extensional capability compliance is therefore not epistemic temporal cleanliness.
selectionFinding: Curated trials repeatedly select discriminating prototype/field/abuse/monitoring tests rather than immediate universal deployment, but the treatment measures selection over a supplied route set and cannot establish proposal competence.
worldModelUpdate: HD6 strengthens the separation among physical action availability, action-class compliance, epistemic temporal cleanliness, structured-evidence validity and research-value correctness. A capability manifest can constrain what kind of action is proposed without erasing pretrained knowledge about where inside that action class to look.
